title: Candidate for Dental Implants: Who Qualifies? Complete Guide
seoTitle: Who Is a Candidate for Dental Implants?
seoDescription: Bone, gum health, medical stability and lifestyle decide implant candidacy more than age. See where you stand and book a CBCT consult in Valencia.
excerpt: Clinicians weigh five things before recommending implants. Learn what they are, which health conditions change the plan, and what to ask at your consult.
keyTakeaways: Candidacy rests on bone volume, gum health, medical stability, lifestyle factors and realistic expectations.
Well-controlled diabetes is usually compatible with implants; poor control raises infection and healing risk.
Age alone is rarely a barrier; implants are placed in patients from their 20s to their 80s.
Too little bone does not rule you out: grafting, sinus lifts, short implants or overdentures are options.
Smoking raises failure and peri-implantitis risk; stopping before surgery and through healing improves odds.

flags: PMC4647895 is cited both for diabetes guidance and for 90-98% ten-year survival; the reference is unverified and reused across posts.
Consult question mentions an implant 'warranty period', which implies a warranty the practice may not offer.
'In our experience' claim about placing implants in patients from their 20s to 80s is an experience claim the copy guide discourages.
Reddit anecdotes ($30,000 quote, $40,000 saved, lost dental-school slot) are used as evidence.
Zygomatic implants are listed as an option; the practice does not list this service.
